applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association with the United States (Title 11 fiscal and financial protocols)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States (2014/2016)
FATCA Intergovernmental Agreement with the United States (effective 2013)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) (ratified)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering (Prevention) Act 2011 (MLPA), as amended; Money Laundering (Prevention) Regulations 2014; Business Corporations Act 1990 (BCA), ss.62-70 (register of directors and members), as amended; Beneficial Ownership Information Order 2018 issued under the BCA; and the RMI-US Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2016).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the Resident Agent and authorizing incorporation filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of each ultimate beneficial owner

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of unexpired passport bio-data page for each natural-person UBO holding 10% or more equity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority or notary public in the issuer's country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing and register of directors for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry / companies registrar in the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or source of wealth declaration for each UBO benefitting from the target payment rails (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution where the UBO maintains the account, or a certified attorney / CPA

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, and beneficial settlement accounts against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury sanctions, and the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit's domestic PEP/sanctions reference. Screening is refreshed at onboarding, upon any change in ownership, and on an event-driven basis; enhanced negative-news and global PEP classification applies to any individual that has held a prominent public function within the prior 12 months.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations - corporate name reservation and incorporation docket (filed exclusively through licensed Registered Agents; no direct public self-service portal is available)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be in Roman alphabet English characters. Non-Roman script names are accepted only when transliterated and accompanied by an English translation or explanation. Permitted corporate suffixes are 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', 'corp.', 'inc.', 'ltd.' or the abbreviation 'LLC' (the latter solely for limited liability companies, not for Business Corporations).
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Trust, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Fiduciary, University, College, Chamber of Commerce, Board of Trade
Sovereign, Government, Marshall Islands Government, Central Bank, Reserve, Ministry, National, State, Crown, Royal
Any word implying connection with a foreign government, multilateral institution, or international agency without written consent
Any name identical or confusingly similar to an existing corporation, reserved name, or registered trademark in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar rejects the proposed name, the applicant may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice. The appeal must set out prior user rights, documentary evidence, or a written consent from the conflicting registrant, together with any alternative name. The Registrar shall issue a determination within 30 working days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may file an administrative review petition with the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 21 days of the denial.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office / hosted registered office at the Resident Agent's physical address is permitted for a non-resident Business Corporation engaged in a voice streaming social application, provided that the Resident Agent has consented in writing and can accept and forward service of process. The entity has no statutory obligation to maintain a physical operational office in RMI. However, because the business uses App Store payment rails (Apple IAP / Google Play Billing) and will handle consumer funds, the Resident Agent may apply enhanced due diligence and require evidence of accurate financial records before accepting the engagement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; estimated annual probability of a physical compliance visit of approximately 5% to 10% for a medium-risk, non-licensed non-resident corporation. Inspections, when conducted, are directed at the Registered Agent's records and the registered office location, not at the subscriber's foreign operational premises, and are generally triggered by Suspicious Activity Reports, law enforcement inquiries, or unusual fund flows.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the Business Corporation Fees Order, as amended; non-recurring.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Agent and registered office services, initial year, including service-of-process acceptance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for non-resident RMI business corporations (range USD 450-600).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT UBO identification, PEP/sanctions screening and initial beneficial ownership register maintenance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered Agent acting as initial AML/CFT compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a medium-risk non-financial non-resident corporation (range USD 250-400).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and consular legalization bundle for UBO passports, power of attorney and corporate shareholder documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority or consular chamber in the country of issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Combined notary fee, Hague Apostille fee, translation fee and courier charges; actual cost varies by jurisdiction.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder (if the UBO is a corporate entity)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-jurisdiction corporate registry or authorized search agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registry statutory fee plus courier fee; one certificate per corporate shareholder.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: English translation and legalisation of non-English UBO documentary evidence (per document set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 15-25 per certified page, assuming a four-page bundle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and preliminary name report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered Agent or registered search provider

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Expedited incorporation and name clearance surcharge (optional, 1-2 working days processing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory expedite fee, separate from standard tariff; payable only if elected.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (Title 33 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Chapter 1), as amended, including all provisions on articles of incorporation, registered office and agent, directors, and shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Division, Office of the Attorney General, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; shares may be issued for such consideration as the board of directors determines under the Business Corporations Act. No escrow account or paid-up capital deposit is required for non-resident business corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscriber's acquisition of 100,000 common shares, par value USD 0.50 per share, be approved, accepted, and recorded on the share ledger; RESOLVED, that the registered office be fixed at [Registered Agent Physical Address], Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and that [Registered Agent] be appointed as registered agent for service of process; RESOLVED, that [President], [Treasurer], and [Secretary] be appointed as officers to serve until successors are elected, each authorized to execute banking, licensing, and operational agreements for the voice-streaming application business; and RESOLVED, that all prior acts consistent herewith are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name availability inquiry or reservation request to the Registrar using a corporate service provider. The proposed name must include a corporate suffix such as 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Limited', or an abbreviation. Reserve the name for a period of 30 days by paying the applicable reservation fee.
required_dossiers: Beneficial owner declaration if reservation is filed through a registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused because it is identical or misleadingly similar to an existing entity, submit three alternative names in priority order or obtain a notarized letter of no-objection from the existing name holder.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles of Incorporation and Appointment of Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized Registered Agent / Corporate Service Provider in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation specifying the corporation's name, purpose clause covering digital audio content streaming and lawful business activity, authorised capital, registered office physical address in Majuro, and registered agent details. The incorporator must sign the Articles, and the registered agent must countersign its acceptance. The registered agent must retain the executed original in the corporate kit.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Consent, with physical address in Majuro
Passport copy of incorporator and ultimate beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent or Registrar objects to the wording or to the agent's capacity, the Articles may be re-executed with amended text or a substitute registered agent within 5 business days at no additional filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial and Corporate Division, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Incorporation and the registered agent consent with the Office of the Attorney General. Remit the official state filing fee of USD 500 by wire transfer or approved electronic gateway. Upon successful verification, the Registrar will endorse the Articles and issue the Certificate of Incorporation, which creates the corporate personality.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation, signed and registered agent accepted
Formal cover letter from the corporate service provider
Statement of non-resident corporate status, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for completeness or fee discrepancy, the corporate service provider may submit the requested clarification or corrected documents within 10 business days. A re-filing without substantive change is not subject to a fresh state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, Bylaws Adoption, and First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator and Initial Board of Directors (private corporate action; no government filing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold an organizational meeting of the incorporator or act by unanimous written consent. Adopt the corporate bylaws, approve the issuance of initial shares to the subscriber, elect the initial directors, appoint the officers, and adopt the pro-forma first board resolution. Record all actions in the corporate minute book and share ledger.
required_dossiers: Organizational meeting minutes or unanimous written consent
Share subscription agreement and share ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any omission in the organizational minutes may be cured by execution of a unanimous written consent of the directors or shareholders ratifying the minutes without further corporate formality.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business License and Taxpayer Identification Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business License Division, Ministry of Finance and Treasury, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Business License Application to the Ministry of Finance and Treasury together with a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation. Pay the annual business license fee according to the corporate license schedule. Upon approval, the Ministry will issue the Business License and the taxpayer identification number (TIN).
required_dossiers: Registered agent certificate and registered office consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business License Division issues a deficiency notice, the applicant has 15 days to cure using corrected documents. An ultimate denial may be administratively appealed to the Minister of Finance in writing within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the non-resident voice-streaming application company does not operate any physical industrial, manufacturing, or processing facility in the Marshall Islands.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial or physical operating license is required for the remote voice-streaming application business under Marshall Islands law.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMIEPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the company does not undertake physical development, construction, or waste-producing activities in the Marshall Islands; therefore no environmental impact assessment or environmental registration is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to RMI operations. The company will rely on cloud infrastructure providers' compliance with applicable international data centre emission and e-waste standards. If any business activity involves personal data of RMI residents, the company will follow RMI data privacy and electronic communications regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable - the company has no physical workplace, employees, or premises in the Marshall Islands. Fire safety certification, structural load inspections, and workplace occupational clearance are not required. The company's remote workforce and cloud-hosted infrastructure are governed by the contractual standards of the technology hosts.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Majuro); corporate registration: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General; offshore registry portal: https://rmioffshore.com
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No statutory TIN or VAT ID is issued to non-resident Business Corporations. A foreign parent forms the BC under the Business Corporation Act (BCA), receives a corporate registration number from the Registrar of Corporations, and may file the BCA Section 51 application for a certificate of exemption from local taxation for all income derived outside RMI. No tax registration, e-filing profile, or ID number is required. If the entity later conducts RMI-source business, it must obtain a Business License from the Business License Registrar; the license number then serves as the tax identifier. Official currency: USD.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No income tax, VAT/GST, hybrid mismatch, or check-the-box regime exists. The only relevant election is the BCA Section 51 tax-exemption certificate for non-resident corporations, granting elective exemption from all RMI taxation; alternatively, a corporation carrying on RMI business may elect to hold a Business License and pay the fixed or gross-receipts Business License Tax instead of remaining exempt.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — the RMI levies no VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax. Indirect-type charges are limited to customs import duties on physical goods entering the RMI and the local Business License Tax, which applies only to persons carrying on business within the RMI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT/GST registration threshold exists. The Business License Tax is triggered by the existence of RMI business activities rather than a turnover threshold; non-resident offshore voice-streaming revenues are outside the regime. Local currency: USD — applicable threshold: N/A.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI has no real-time fiscal clearance, no mandatory e-invoicing API or tax authority clearance platform, and no digital stamping requirement. Non-resident BCs may freely issue invoices outside the RMI without country-specific formatting.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — there is no VAT in the RMI, so no export VAT zero-rating is available or required. Export of digital services is instead tax-neutral under the territorial rule: a non-resident Business Corporation performing no RMI-source activity is exempt from all RMI taxation under BCA Section 51, regardless of customer location or place of consumption.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable — no RMI VAT export-refund mechanism exists; no customs export declaration is required for digital voice-streaming services supplied by a non-resident BC.
Customs Export Declaration (RMI Customs Service) — relevant only if tangible goods were physically exported from RMI territory.
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill — relevant only for physical exports from RMI.
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement proving receipt of foreign-source revenue — recommended for substantiating BCA Section 51 exempt status.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback is possible because no VAT is imposed. The relevant exposure is misrepresentation of non-resident status to obtain or retain the BCA Section 51 tax-exemption certificate. Consequences include revocation of the exemption certificate, back-assessment of any Business License Tax found due for RMI-source activities, monetary penalties under the Business License Act, corporate dissolution or penalties for non-filed annual reports, and criminal liability for fraud under the RMI Criminal Code. The 180-day FX-repatriation figure supplied in the schema is not a statutory RMI deadline, as the RMI maintains no exchange controls.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists; the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has adopted the United States dollar as its sole legal tender. Reserve management and monetary policy are de facto delegated to the U.S. Federal Reserve. The banking and financial services sector is regulated by the Registrar of Corporations and the Banking Commissioner within the Ministry of Finance, acting under the Banking Act 1988 and the Business Corporations Act 1990.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full and unrestricted convertibility, given the RMI's official currency is the USD. Both current and capital account transactions are free from exchange controls. There are no administrative barriers to profit remittance, dividend distribution, or capital repatriation for non-resident or foreign-owned Business Corporations. The absence of a domestic central bank and exchange control law means no formal approval is required for inward or outward transfers. The only applicable constraints are anti-money laundering (AML) reporting requirements and correspondent bank compliance policies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline exists for the surrender of export proceeds. RMI law imposes no obligation on exporters to convert, repatriate, or remit export receipts to local bank accounts. All export proceeds may be retained offshore or in any currency, as the USD is already the settlement vehicle. Mandatory conversion ratios are zero.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / USD Demand Deposit Account
Capital Escrow Account (project finance / escrow arrangements)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. RMI does not have a fintech licensing regime or electronic money institution (EMI) framework. Offshore digital EMIs are not recognized as authorized deposit-taking institutions and cannot obtain direct access to RMI domestic payment infrastructure. A non-resident Marshall Islands Business Corporation may maintain an account with a foreign-licensed EMI (e.g., an EU or UK EMI), but such an account is not a substitute for a domestic bank account and may trigger AML concerns due to lack of RMI regulatory oversight. The enhanced due diligence burden on downstream correspondent banks makes this route operationally fragile for a voice streaming app.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is generally required for corporate account opening with Bank of the Marshall Islands. Although the bank may accept a remote video KYC interview in limited circumstances for existing clients or high-net-worth introductions, a statutory mandate does not formally permit fully remote opening for foreign-owned non-resident corporations. In practice, the recommendation is that the beneficial owner and at least one director attend an in-person onboarding session in Majuro or Ebeye. If physical presence is impossible, a face-to-face interview with an overseas notary and apostilled certification package can be presented, but approval is at the sole discretion of the bank's compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident tax-exempt structure with no local substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate registry certificate, certificate of good standing, board resolution appointing signatories, detailed business plan proving actual activity (voice streaming platform operations), description of the app store distribution channel (Apple App Store, Google Play), and a formal entity substance statement confirming the tax-exempt status under the RMI Business Corporations Act.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction / offshore financial secrecy flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Beneficial ownership register filed with the RMI Registrar of Corporations, legal proof of underlying business in a lower-risk market (e.g., United States or European Union), audited financial statements or opening balance sheet, and a sworn affidavit of lawful source of funds sourced from the director's bank statements showing provable capital injection history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-Risk Enhanced AML tier due to voice streaming revenue via app stores
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: App store payout statements (Apple/Google financial reports), license agreements with app distribution platforms, customer behavior-based monitoring program description (transaction waterfall, velocity rules, geographic blocklists), and a standalone AML/CFT compliance manual approved by the bank's compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions from shareholders or parent companies are routed through the U.S. Federal Reserve System via correspondent bank wires. The recommended protocol is a SWIFT MT103 wire from the investing entity's bank to the RMI corporate account at Bank of the Marshall Islands, using the corporate account number and BOMI's U.S. correspondent bank routing number. Because the USD is the RMI domestic currency, no foreign exchange conversion occurs. The purpose code should accurately reflect the transaction as 'contribution to capital of a legally incorporated entity' or 'additional paid-in capital' — the standard code used by U.S. correspondent banks is 'C005' (Capital transfer) under IMF Balance of Payments classification. The shareholder must submit a board resolution authorizing the injection, the subscription agreement or share allotment certificate, and a source-of-wealth statement to satisfy the financial institution's AML checks.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade and supplier settlements are executed in USD through the clearing infrastructure of the U.S. Federal Reserve. For payments exceeding the bank's local clearing threshold or to non-U.S. beneficiaries, bank remittances use the SWIFT MT103 network. For commercial letter of credit (LC) transactions, the RMI business corporation may use an issuing bank's SWIFT MT700 (LC issuance) followed by MT103/MT202 transfers for reimbursement. If the beneficiary holds a USD account at a U.S. bank, a domestic ACH/wire via the correspondent bank is also permissible. There is no RMI domestic clearing house, hence all cross-border disbursements are processed through international correspondent banks subject to OFAC sanctions screening. Standard payment rails include: (a) SWIFT MT103 direct credit to beneficiary bank; (b) commercial documentary collections under the ICC Uniform Customs & Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600); (c) for recurring low-value royalties and content licensor fees, push payments through Automated Clearing House (ACH) in the U.S. if both parties maintain domestic USD accounts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright USD/XCY FX Forwards with a licensed non-RMI financial institution (executed offshore, as no domestic FX market exists)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing emerging market currencies for conversion of app store proceeds from regional local-currency listings
Cross-currency swaps for long-term debt or intercompany loan exposure denominated in a non-USD currency

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Report and Annual Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls (e.g., if incorporated on 15 April, filing due by 30 April annually)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% of the unpaid franchise tax, administrative suspension of corporate rights, and continued non-payment for a full year may lead to involuntary administrative dissolution by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, unless the company is publicly listed, subject to a specific shareholder/board resolution, or otherwise designated under applicable regulation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP as adopted by the board; no statutory local GAAP is promulgated; financial statements do not need to be publicly filed.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must conduct an annual review and confirmation of beneficial ownership data from the directors and shareholders; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership triggers a fresh UBO confirmation within a short deadline. Verified UBO information is retained by the registered agent and made available to the Registrar or law enforcement upon lawful request.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 2,500 per annum depending on corporate service provider and complexity
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; if an independent audit is voluntarily performed for lender or investor purposes, typical market range is USD 8,000 – USD 20,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-resident Business Corporations wholly foreign-owned and deriving no Marshall Islands source income are fully exempt from income tax, gross revenue tax, and all local levies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Marshall Islands income tax return is required for a Non-Resident Tax-Exempt Business Corporation; the sole statutory compliance filing is the Annual Report / Franchise Tax Report filed with the Registrar of Corporations (via the Register of Corporations online portal maintained by the RMI Office of the Registrar).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment are due on or before the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation occurs (typically within 30 days after the anniversary date).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact registered corporate name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the BCA certificate number exactly as issued; do not abbreviate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and registered office street address in RMI
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a valid RMI corporate services license; a PO Box is not a permissible street address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of each director and officer
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; provide full legal name and passport/foreign address for each.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares and par value
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the share structure authorized by the articles; no minimum capitalization is required.
For a non-resident exempt BC, the annual fee is calculated on authorized shares (typically a flat USD 450–500 minimum plus per-share components); a zero-income declaration may be attached.
Confirm that the corporation is 100% foreign-owned, has no RMI source income, and is not conducting a trade or business within RMI.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the Annual Report by the deadline triggers a late fee of USD 500 plus USD 50 per month or fraction thereof, possible administrative dissolution, and loss of good standing; reinstatement after dissolution requires payment of all arrearages and a fresh certificate of good standing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Republic of the Marshall Islands maintains no comprehensive income tax treaty network and imposes no dividend withholding tax. No DTA relief application, Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), or certification procedure is necessary for non-resident shareholders; a TRC may be issued by the RMI Revenue Division for foreign credit purposes, but it is unrelated to dividend relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory; 0% treaty (no applicable DTA). Interest and royalty payments to or from non-resident BCs are not subject to Marshall Islands withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Marshall Islands statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold applies to non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporations. As an OECD-compliant best practice, Local File and Master File should be prepared when the entity's OECD-reportable group turnover exceeds USD 5 million, and the entity must not create an RMI permanent establishment.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance Regulations require only entities conducting geographically mobile 'relevant activities' (banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing, leasing, headquarters, distribution or service centers, and intellectual property holding) to demonstrate adequate substance in RMI. A voice-streaming social app monetized through Apple IAP and Google Play Billing does not constitute a relevant activity if it does not hold exploitable intellectual property for the purpose of earning royalty income; however, if the BC books royalty or licence income from the app's copyrighted technology, IP-related economic substance rules may be triggered. Best practice: maintain local board minutes, accounting records, and present substantive management presence in a DTA-compliant jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Facilitation of Tax Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI BC as a sham conduit to earn undeclared aggressive-income, or knowingly facilitating shareholder tax evasion in a foreign jurisdiction (e.g., concealing Apple App Store/Google Play revenue from the shareholder's tax authority).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Criminal Code and Tax Act, substantial monetary penalties up to USD 500,000 for each offense and up to 10 years imprisonment for responsible persons; also criminal forfeiture of the digital platform revenues.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign false declarations or direct the misreporting of the corporation's controlled foreign income are personally liable for civil restitution and are subject to extradition to the shareholder's tax jurisdiction under a mutual legal assistance treaty request.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a zero-employee, zero-asset RMI corporation that functions as a mere letterbox and fails to demonstrate tax residence anywhere, especially when accompanied by foreign bank accounts or app-store payout flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations and Business Corporations Act, the Registrar may impose a penalty of USD 50,000, strike the company off the register, and order the disclosure of beneficial owners; repeated non-compliance triggers criminal liability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally disqualified from acting as a director or corporate officer in RMI for up to 10 years, and may incur civil damages for misrepresentation to third-party creditors and app-platform partners.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML Breach via Digital Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Apple IAP and Google Play Billing proceeds without a functional AML/CFT risk assessment, without monitoring suspicious user transactions related to the voice chat rooms, or with payment proceeds routed through an RMI shell bank account to mask beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the RMI Money Laundering Prevention Act carry fines up to USD 100,000 and 20 years imprisonment; the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze corporate bank accounts and seize digital payout receivable balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are jointly and severally liable for money laundering penalties, travel bans are routinely imposed until account restitution is made, and non-resident directors are subject to arrest under regional RMI-US extradition arrangements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Report / Franchise Tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful or negligent failure to file the annual report, resulting in administrative dissolution without winding-up formalities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An administrative dissolution order, loss of limited liability protection, recovery of all unpaid fees plus penalties, and inability to enforce app-store contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who continue to transact business after dissolution become personally and jointly liable for all debts and obligations incurred post-dissolution, including app-payable refunds and supplier claims.
